good_to_know.text: Bookshop Saturday 17:00–18:30, Sunday 09:00–12:30. Emergency exit diagram on bulletin page 1.

events.title: Family Mass
events.text: Catechism children and families join parish worship.

events.title: Letters of 1 &2 Peter — Bible Study
events.text: Fr Ambrose Vaz; Sundays 4/11/18 October 15:00–17:00, Level 3 MPH. Registration QR on poster.

events.title: October Scripture Rosary
events.text: Sundays in October 16:30, led by Eucharistic Ministers.

events.title: Hospitality Minister Commissioning
events.text: Hospitality Ministers will be commissioned this Sunday, 22nd November 2026 at 11am Mass. Please support your HMs with your prayers.

events.title: PIETA Zoom session
events.text: Support group for bereaved parents. Next Zoom session is on Tuesday 24 November, 7:30pm to 9:15pm. Email pieta.singapore@gmail.com for Zoom link.

events.title: Seeds of Growth
events.text: A-levels/IB students, join us for a time of prayer, sharing, and fellowship. Dates: Sat, 28 Nov, 10AM to 12PM & Fri, 4 Dec, 2PM to 4PM. Venue: L8, Catholic Centre (55 Waterloo Street, S187954). Sign up at tinyurl.com/OYPSOGNOV26.

events.title: Advent Retreat for LGBTQ
events.text: "The Lord is Near: Come Home to Him who Comes." Stay-in weekend retreat from Friday 4 Dec (7pm) to Sunday, 6 Dec (4pm). Register at tinyurl.com/couragedadvent2026.

events.title: OYP NS Community Outreach
events.text: All National Servicemen (NSFs) are invited to a morning of fellowship, worship and prayer. Date: Saturday, 5 December 2026, 10.30am. Venue: Level 8, Catholic Centre, 55 Waterloo Street, Singapore 187954. Registration: tinyurl.com/CAYADECOUTREACH.

events.title: Christmas Carolling
events.text: Jubilate Choir will be spreading Christmas joy this December with house-to-house carolling. Dates: Dec 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, 20. Time: 5pm or 8pm. Contact Germain @98882666 or scan the QR code or approach our choir after Mass.

events.title: SCDF Responder Plus Programme
events.text: 09:00–12:30 Church of St Stephen; free first aid, CPR-AED and basic firefighting training. Register by 1 October at office,6747 1433 or css.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.

events.title: BREATHE Youth Retreat
events.text: Stay-in retreat for 16-30yos on 16-20 Dec. Registration at bit.ly/breathe4 and closes on 30 Nov. Organised by the Catholic Spirituality Centre (CSC).

events.title: A Light in the Darkness
events.text: This Christmas Eve, experience a moving musical play of struggle, hope and faith. Join us on 24 December 2026 at 11.00pm, followed by Christmas Carolling at 11.40pm and our Christmas Mass at 12 midnight.

devotions.text: Saturday Rosary 16:45. Divine Mercy Sunday 10:15. October Scripture Rosary Sundays 16:30, led by the Eucharistic Ministers.

getting_there.text: Mattar MRT DT25 ExitB, ~6-minute/450m walk via Mattar Road/Sallim Road, back gate beside The Antares. Bus 62/64/100 at Canossa Catholic Primary, Aljunied Road 70029, ~7 minutes to front gate;40/61/63/65/135/154/155/158 opposite Mattar ExitB70231, ~6 minutes to back gate.
Limited church parking. During events/carpark closure use 52A Pipit Road multistorey carpark,360m away.

sacraments.text: Contact parish office for infant baptism; no preparation dates stated.
One year notification required; contact parish office.
Notify priest immediately and discuss funeral services in person before making arrangements with casket company. Wake enquiries Faith Liu.
Office assists urgent sacramental needs; outside normal office route use Faith.

ministries.name: Paradisum Wake Prayer Ministry
ministries.text: Evening prayers in church prayer rooms, funeral parlours or HDB void decks; members respond at short notice. Transport from church provided when needed. Membership enquiry form linked.

ministries.name: Music Ministry
ministries.text: The Rock Saturday 17:30, Cantores Fidei Sunday 09:00, Jubilate Sunday 11:00, plus Sunday 17:30 choir. Join via ministry contact form.
